vm-bot.note: The reviewer stub, baked into the release image's app dir (docker/Dockerfile) and re-installed 0444 by the daemon mode if missing; the dev build's rsync keeps its own anchored exclude.

vm-lens.note: A lens session runs in its parent's cwd with the parent's environment, so it loads what the parent loads.

bench.note: The same stub as production, copied into the image's cwd (bench/aacr/Dockerfile).

bench-lens.note: A lens session runs in its parent's cwd with the parent's environment, so it loads what the parent loads.

release-image.note: The reviewer stub baked at the image's app dir (docker/Dockerfile), root-owned and read-only; the agentDir sits under the fixed HOME and holds no context file. A route that gives pi its own cwd (the clone route's out dir) gets its own copy of the stub.

release-image-lens.note: A lens session runs in its parent's cwd with the parent's environment, so it loads what the parent loads.

bench-judge.note: Runs in the PR's own checkout, whose AGENTS.md must not reach the judge.

clone-review.note: cwd is the run's own out dir under the state home, outside every checkout, holding a copy of the reviewer stub (src/hostroute.ts); the agentDir is a private one with no context file.

clone-review-lens.note: A lens session runs in its parent's cwd with the parent's environment, so it loads what the parent loads.

sdk.note: PiHost.makeSession (packages/pi-plugin/src/engine/pisdk.ts): the ResourceLoader discovers nothing and agentsFilesOverride hands over the reviewer stub at the run's out dir; the file is never written, and the planted AGENTS.md in the cwd, its ancestor and the agentDir do not load.

sdk-lens.note: An SDK lens session comes from the same makeSession with the same context files (D34: the stub on every route).

scan-leaf-container.note: cwd is the app root in the scan container (QCR_ROOT=/opt/qcr), which the companion image fills with an explicit COPY list that has no context file. The leaf passes -nc besides: it loads none whatever the root holds.

scan-leaf-host.note: [scan] sandbox = "host": cwd is sandboxRoot(), the qcr checkout, whose AGENTS.md the leaf does not load (-nc, P1.1); nothing is written there or into the scanned tree.

companion.note: /workspace is the qcr checkout, bind-mounted; no stub. The release image in companion mode: its WORKDIR (/opt/qcr, where the stub sits) is overridden by the run.
